description: Create a CRM follow-up task for you or, where your assignment policy allows, another active member. Optionally link it to a CRM account or conversation you can see. dueAt must be an exact datetime with a timezone; resolve relative dates such as "tomorrow" with the user first.

dueAt.description: Exact ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset or Z. Relative dates like "tomorrow" must be resolved by the user first.

ownerId.description: Owner users.id. Defaults to you. Null leaves the task unassigned.

relatedId.description: ID of the account or conversation named by relatedType

relatedType.description: Link to a CRM account or conversation. Default none.

name: create_crm_task

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
